definitionZh: 滚动边距 CSS 短手属性将元素的全部滚动边距同时设置, 分配值与元素边距的边距相似 。
sourceDefinition: The scroll-margin CSS shorthand property sets all of the scroll margins of an element at once, assigning values much like the margin property does for margins of an element.
